question: Why does the live CD start a QEMU AHCI controller with storahci, and why does that disk identify as QEMU HARDDISK?
allowedInputs: boot/bootdata/hivesys.inf and txtsetup.sif already in the tree, which bound PCI class 0106 to pciide and left a commented storahci alternative
drivers/storage/port/storahci and drivers/storage/port/storport already in the tree
sdk/include/reactos/drivers/ata/identify_funcs.h and the ATA string copy in drivers/storage/ide/atapi already in the tree
Serial logs from booting this tree: output/storahci/boot.log and output/drivers-test/boot.log

harness.name: qemu-system-i386 with ich9-ahci and a fat disk

cursor.prompt: Let's work on the next milestone. Milestone 5: Driver Compatibility Foundation. Goal: Load modern Windows drivers. Focus: IRP handling, PnP manager, power manager, DMA support.

measuredEffect.metric: AHCI disk identity in the live-CD serial log
measuredEffect.after: SCSI Disk ATA QEMU HARDDISK revision 2.5+
measuredEffect.note: Before this change class 0106 was bound to pciide and storahci was not loaded, so there was no storahci disk identity to record. After, the boot log named SCSI\Disk&Ven_ATA&Prod_QEMU_HARDDISK&Rev_2.5+.
